issues.legal_issue: A petitioner seeking discretionary appellate relief must disclose interim court orders that materially bear on the issue raised, and suppression of those orders may warrant dismissal of the petition.
material_facts: The petitioners sought special leave to challenge the dismissal of their challenge to a land acquisition, arguing that the acquisition proceedings had lapsed because the awards were not made within the prescribed time.
Interim orders had stayed or affected proceedings concerning the lands: an earlier order directed status quo as to possession, and later orders stayed further acquisition proceedings.
The special leave petitions did not disclose those interim orders; the respondents brought them to the Court's attention in their counter-affidavit.

The interim orders were material because, under the explanation to Section 11-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, time during which action or proceedings pursuant to a declaration were stayed by a court order was excluded.
issues.conclusion: The special leave petitions were dismissed because the petitioners suppressed material facts. Relief under Article 136 is discretionary, and a petitioner seeking it must make frank and full disclosure.
issues.legal_principle: Relief under Article 136 of the Constitution is discretionary, and a petitioner seeking it must make frank and full disclosure of material facts; suppression of facts directly bearing on the question raised may justify dismissal. The explanation to Section 11-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, excludes from the relevant period time during which action or proceedings pursuant to a declaration are stayed by a court order. Section 36 of the Bangalore Development Act, 1976, applied the Land Acquisition Act provisions, so far as applicable, to acquisitions otherwise than by agreement. No earlier cases were relied on.

predicates.discretionary_appellate_relief_sought: The applicant seeks discretionary appellate relief from a court.
predicates.material_interim_orders_exist: Interim court orders exist that bear directly on an issue raised in the proceeding.
predicates.material_interim_orders_not_disclosed: The applicant does not disclose those material interim orders in the application.

issues.definition: If an applicant seeks discretionary appellate relief and fails to disclose interim court orders that bear directly on an issue raised, the petition is dismissed for material suppression.
